typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		ActualDate as timestamp,
		TradeDate as timestamp,
		SettleDate as timestamp,
		QuantityAmt as decimal(24,8),
		PrincipalAmt as decimal(24,8),
		CommissionAmt as decimal(24,8),
		TradePrice as decimal(24,10),
		CostAmt as decimal(24,8),
		ProductType1 as string,
		ProductType2 as string,
		CUSIP as string,
		TickerSymbol as string,
		InstrumentDescription1 as string,
		TransactionTypeDescription1 as string,
		TransactionTypeDescription2 as string,
		DivisionDescription as string,
		DistrictDescription as string,
		SubDistrict1Description as string,
		Inventory as string,
		CustomerDescription1 as string,
		CustomerTypeDescription as string,
		ICISClientNum as decimal(10,0),
		BackOfficeInventory as string,
		ICISSystemKey as string,
		SourceTransactionId as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(GetDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> ToAddLoadDate
ToAddLoadDate sink(input(
		SubDistrict1Description as string,
		ProductType2 as string,
		ICISClientNum as string,
		ProductType1 as string,
		Load_Date as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ActualDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CUSIP as string,
		TransactionTypeDescription2 as string,
		CustomerDescription1 as string,
		PrincipalAmt as integer,
		TickerSymbol as string,
		TransactionTypeDescription1 as string,
		BackOfficeInventory as string,
		TradeDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		SourceTransactionId as string,
		DistrictDescription as string,
		SettleDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CommissionAmt as integer,
		InstrumentDescription1 as string,
		QuantityAmt as integer,
		DivisionDescription as string,
		TradePrice as integer,
		ICISSystemKey as string,
		CostAmt as integer,
		CustomerTypeDescription as string,
		Inventory as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		SubDistrict1Description,
		ProductType2,
		ICISClientNum,
		ProductType1,
		Load_Date = GetDate,
		ActualDate,
		CUSIP,
		TransactionTypeDescription2,
		CustomerDescription1,
		PrincipalAmt,
		TickerSymbol,
		TransactionTypeDescription1,
		BackOfficeInventory,
		TradeDate,
		SourceTransactionId,
		DistrictDescription,
		SettleDate,
		CommissionAmt,
		InstrumentDescription1,
		QuantityAmt,
		DivisionDescription,
		TradePrice,
		ICISSystemKey,
		CostAmt,
		CustomerTypeDescription,
		Inventory),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
